text:
8 years of free updates and counting
Cheap price of $9.99 and frequent sales
Hundreds of hours of gameplay
A crap load of customization options
Amazing mod support
Told Epic Games to go away when they tried to buy them out

How based can a developer get???
If you liked Darkest Dungeon but felt like it needed to be in real time and also have Xenomorphs in it, first seek professional help. However, after that you should probably check this one out.

Mandagon is a short, free exploration title with very solid pixel art. The exploration was a far less interesting than I was hoping for, and without solid gameplay to back it up it sorta feels like wasted time despite the game looking pretty.

its just Halo. but with slightly better graphics and super cringe millennial dialogue. MCC is a far better use of your time and money if you want Halo in your life. the levels are way too bright, especially the library. it takes away form the scariness of the flood when you can see everything clearly.
Yeah this game has a cool mechanic but I beat it in under 2 hours. It’s not worth $25.

Indiana Jones and the Great Circle keeps its gameplay simple and effective, it could be more hardcore and complicated if it wanted but it chose not to, and what we have in the end is still a great game, a timeless masterpiece even. It's easily my favorite game of the year. 

More on the level design, The Vatican feels like MachineGames's version of Prague from Deus Ex: Mankind Divided which changes and opens up bit by bit; Gizeh is a smaller and simpler version of Metal Gear Solid V's Afghanistan; Sukhoutai brings back memories of the second half of Far Cry 2. Even though it's light on immersive sim elements, I believe imsim lovers would still be able to find enjoyment in this game.

Either die a hero, or live long enough to become the villain.  Although I understand the idea of 'balancing' weapons out so you don't have people getting kicked because they're not using the "Meta", this should be done with buffs -- not nerfs. Players unleashing steel hellfire on bots or bugs is what this game is about.  There are no players to harm.   I hope the developers will listen to the community because game is fun as hell.
If you like Mega Man X this game is definitely worth playing. Absolutely loved it. The length is about the same as any Mega Man game. I'd also say for people wanting a challenge play on hard mode.

The game is alright...it could be way better tho. The art style is reminiscent to a painting come to life which is unique for such a game,and its awesome. The score for it is beyond perfect,suits the atmosphere and the inevitable outcome perfectly. Combat is dope,enemies not so much.

It is WAAAY too short tho, u can beat it in 12-15 hours even with all the exploration and side objectives.

Overall 7/10

Easily one of the most important games you could play with others.
That ending was unexpectedly one of the best experiences I've ever had the pleasure of sharing and one which I will never forget.

This is now Abandonware. Holotech is going for the Subscription model with their Animaze software to milk people for their money. Of course everyone is defending this by saying "Facerig exists" Only once this is broken, it will be broken forever. and Animaze will be the ONLY thing you can use. I also heard they are taking this down from Steam. So if you don't already own this, tough luck?

Nioh players will feel right at home instantly. It is truly a Nioh-like. Very addictive and not too difficult.

Play the demo first so you get a B+/B scaling weapon you can carry to the main game.

Hey Jeff Lew if you are reading this...
I was wondering if you can possibly add in like a very funny "What-If" scenario or alternate ending of the game where Cappuccino's nephew aka the DJ Bean turns down the music for Killer Bean's request from the phone call complaint when trying to get sleep that night. That way the entire game ends just like that as a massive joke that would've happened in the Killer Bean Forever movie if the DJ Bean didn't mock him over the phone. 
I would love to get feedback over this funny request for the game if possible! ^^
Also... love the game, I hope more content comes out for August, and hopefully Multiplayer with friends gets added soon, can't for this game to be big and hit the consoles!! (:

It's fun and stuff but the writing/voice acting (especially the Journalist's) is painfully bad and wasn't proofread by someone fluent in English so it really makes you feel like a confused, senile geriatric feller. 
For the love of God please stop putting Cthulhu and fish-people into every single "Lovecraft-inspired" story.

This game is literally so good. I thought the previous one was excellent and this one just blew it out of the water . I have never been so jazzed about 100% a game series. It builds on everything from the first game and just adds that touch of refinement. I am obsessed with this game and want to find every single thing. I got the art book today. Love everything about this game.

8/10 

Short, sweet, cute and well drawn little puzzle game more like a little story, It is fun if you just want to follow along a little story. The games of the developer studio often goes to sale and it is wort the time and money to play it.

While I don't think this game is as strong as the first one, its still a pretty good experience.

Visuals are great, and the score and sound design is phenomenal, puzzles are ok but never get really challenging, the weakest point I think is the story, which starts of strong but disappoints somewhat towards the end.

Gameplay and mechanics are almost identical to the first, don't expect any surprises there, and I might suggest not playing the two close together.
The game is a genuine continuation of the first game. The combat is more detailed in such a good way, and they kept that damn good art style.
This is the best run 'n gun shooter that I've played since Super Contra.  The gunplay, sound effects, and pixel art are all top tier.  The challenges are tough too.  Great game.

400+ hours, from a perspective of a "souls" player the game is pretty fun mostly the depth of night, because it challenges you to become a "better player"... I like that this doesn't have any "cool" reward because from software always has been a company who see everyone as equals and not because you're high rank you are better than someone who plays for fun with their friend for example. The game is pretty good, people say is a copy from old fromsoftware titles, and well is a good opportunity to show off the previous enemies and keep the knowledge from previous soulsgames, now the fact that the game has NEW bosses is exciting. However what I didn't like is that the dlc came with only two new bosses could be 3 or 4. But in general I recommend it 100% PRAISE THE SUN FRIENDS

So I'm not going to give this a negative score because I do think this is a great game. But I'm too old for parry-based gameplay and the game basically relies on it. The enemies are overly aggressive and if you don't parry them, they basically stun lock you. Overall the core gameplay loop is fun, just not the combat. Especially bosses who give zero breathing room.

great game, fun combat and parkour, BUT i'll warn you about something, if you boot the game and your saves are suddenly gone DO, NOT MAKE A NEW ONE! making a new one will delete all your old saves! just quit the game and reboot it,, your saves will be back, i looked it up before i started a new save thankfully.
I loved the first steamworld dig, and this sequel is better in every way, wonderful, highly recommended.

usually fun game with unlimited replayability, highly recommend trying (make sure to play with all the dlcs)
🔪 🐶

Short but great.

I really loved how they flowed the DLC in between chapter 5 and 6 with no awkward pause in gameplay.
Seeying Ennio Salieir and Frank Colleti in their younger versions were great, nice connection with Mafia 1
The 2 new chapter were pretty action packed with cool chases and a nice new indoor area.

The DLC did end a bit abrypt after the last chase without Ennio though

Wait for a steep sale!
It's a pretty good horror experience but the game itself is very short and the combat is more on the basic side. 9 buck is a bit much for it.

A really sad downgrade from the first game. The visuals looks cool, but the further you get, the more mazelike every level is. The majority of the guns are completely useless, ammo is sparse because you'll be using only 2 or 3 guns the whole time while your useless guns are always full. It's completely unbalance, there are dozens of perks, but you're forced to only 3 the entire game so you always feel weak, even near the end of the game. For some strange reason they decided to take out a few of the great guns from the first game and replace them with completely useless ones. Just a downgrade from the first game in every way except for visuals, really sad actually considering how much potential this game has

Absolutely another fantastic horror game from the same developers that made F.E.A.R! Gripping story and atmosphere, great sound design, challanging but rewarding combat. The only issue I can really even think of is that there's some small framerate and audio issues with the steam port of this game. Well, and the fact that I have to buy the sequel on console to figure out where the story goes from here. But I absolutely recommend this great horror game, you won't regret it!

Mission design, gameplay, characters, and story, all incredible. Also, the amount of details and references to the 007 career in film is masterful. It was too short for my preference and the ending falters a little bit, but it is still a 9/10 experience. I enjoyed every bit of time I spent on this game. Waiting for sequel!

Wait a sec?! You mean making a game that's faithful to source material and does not compromise it's vision for 'modern audiences' is possible and the target audience actually likes it?! WHO WOULD HAVE THOUGHT!

Seriously, had a lot of fun so far! To put it in simples terms: Were you the fan of original movie? Wanted to feel like Robo from the movie? Well, there you go! This game is EXACTLY that. No more, no less. Support those devs if you can, they deserve it. Another small team taking a dump on AAA industry - amazing.

Fun game, good mechanics without being too complicated, and the aesthetic is top notch. Overall a good sci-fi shooter.. If that's your jam and you like the look of the of the teaser videos, I think you'll enjoy it. I picked it up on a whim and finished it in just under 7 hours and I think it was worth it.

I’ve never really been a fan of metroidvania games but this game genuinely surprised me..
The exploration, atmosphere, art style, music, and movement all come together so well, there’s always something interesting around the next corner, and the world genuinely made me want to explore every little area I could find, the game feels incredibly polished, charming, and surprisingly addictive, I especially loved how the matchstick mechanic is tied into both combat and exploration instead of just being a gimmick, I honestly didn’t expect to get this hooked on a genre I usually don’t enjoy and I ended up finishing the entire game in just one day LOL

Definitely one of the most memorable experiences I’ve had this year :D

What if the originals DOOMs oldschool gunplay is mixed with a Resident Evil like horror setting, but its a Max Payne like story ...kind of in a different dimension. Painted in Blood is definitely a hidden gem, potentially an artistic masterpiece. In other words, a wonderful high quality horror boomer shooter. Really loved it!

At first, I bought it because the price was low. I thought I'd play for an hour and then stop, but that didn't happen. The more I played, the more it drew me in. As time went on, I started to concentrate. I really enjoyed it and didn't stop until I finished. I recommend you play it.
Pretty fun so far, only issue I have so far is Majima randomly saying english voice lines outside of cutscenes when I'm playing in japenese.
Remake or original, I think Silent Hill 2 is the best horror game ever made, such a good story and atmosphere, and the music is great too.

The absolute best Silent Hill game (not counting remakes) since SH3 on the PS2. Amazing atmosphere and very engaging story. Recent patch fixed all stuttering on PC btw. A very solid 9/10 and def recommend.

Experienced on the Meta Quest 3

You can view my 3D in VR gameplay here: https://youtu.be/VG5cx99czfY

Yes, you can play Bionic Bay in 3D in VR using the completely FREE Geo-11 3D driver. Geo 11 lets you convert most DX 11 games into fully stereoscopic 3D. It's like watching a 3D movie at a 3D movie theater. A big 180 screen in front of you in glorious 3D. 

You might be thinking that Bionic Bay doesn't have any 3D depth, but you'd be wrong. It has a lot of 3D depth. In fact, this game is best played in 3D in VR. It looks & runs great too!

3D in VR Rating 9/10.

I bought this game (in a bundle)! If you enjoyed my review, please consider joining my Steam Curator group Oculus Rift Reviews.

Super surprised more people haven't heard of this game, including me. 

It's a very well made 2D souls-like metroidvania with a good soundtrack and awesome combat. Definitely worth the $6ish paid for it. It's packed full of secrets and the bosses are unique. 

The downsides: The games 3rd boss (might have done it out of order) is by far the hardest, areas generally look samey because the entire game is black and white, and the game doesn't hold your hand at all.
Good game but horrid optimization, when the devs give a shout about a optimization overhaul pick this up, its clearly made by people who care but sadly unplayable if you don't have a crazy computer

Bendy and the Dark Revival is an extremely big step up from the previous game. What I mean by that is that while the story in the previous game shined, the gameplay was extremely lacking and boring to be honest. Meanwhile this game is a different case. what I mean by that is that the gameplay in this game feels much better and is overall an improvement over the last game. The combat is smooth and it feels like you actually are using a weapon rather than paper, and the stealth is FOR SURE much better than the last game, another thing this game nails much more than the last game is the story, the story feels much more interesting and captivating, overall it's worth it's full price.
Pretty fun, cheap, some scares, interesting artstyle, and just a good time overall I do recommend you play this if you think it looks cool because what you see it what you get.

I won't say the game is perfect, it certainly has some really frustrating parts that could be adjusted. BUT, when you unlock everything and start to really feel it, it's a masterpiece of a metroidvania. 

The true ending is just amazing and was well worth the wait all these years. 

Sherma is the best <3

This is a souls game for a very specific group of people. You wanna parry and dance around enemies rather than back up. You wanna combine items and skills to do a lotta damage. You want a story in a new setting with new aesthetics. 

I gotta say as a forewarning, this game is very small enemies focused, with only 10 bosses. There is no secret endings and with very simple puzzles. I personally loved playing this. I'm not the type to 100% games, so don't ask about that experience. If you love parrying, you'll enjoy it. If you hate parrying, idk man there is a weapon for that but it takes away your second hands abilities. The bosses that don't become mini bosses are super fun and I really enjoyed reading lore. Again a very specific group will like this game.

No real performance issues other than having a couple slows at obvious load zones in large areas.

I really loved playing through this game and I consider it one of the best metroidvanias of 2025. With a conscious message about burnout and challenging bosses and platforming, it is the best of both worlds. Seriously, play Constance.
